definitions.short: to knot or distort ; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)
definitions.full: H6140. aqash [ עָקַשׁ ] verb twist (Late Hebrew id. (rare)); — Niph`al Participle construct דְּרָכַיִם Prov 28:18 one crooked in ways (< plural, compare Toy). Pi`el Perfect 3plural לָהֶם עִקְּשׁז Isa 59:8 their paths they have twisted. Imperfect 3masculine plural יְעַקֵּ֑שׁזּ Micah 3:9 all that is straight they make crooked; Participle דְּרָכָיו מְעַקֵּשׁ Prov 10:9 (compare Niph`al ). Hiph`il Imperfect וַיּעְקְשֵׁנִי Job 9:20 (Ges § 53n ) he hath declared me crooked , devious (in life).
